title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.



As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.



You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.


* Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
* Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
* Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.


Key job responsibilities


* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support


A day in the life


* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.



The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up\-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry\-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Gen AI & Data Engineering (Azure)
description:
**Gen AI \& Data Engineering (Azure)**
======================================

Date: Sep 9, 2026
Location:
Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500032


Req ID: 38170
Work Mode: Default
**Summary**
-----------


We’re seeking a hands\-on engineer who blends **GenAI** expertise with solid **data engineering** skills to design, build, and operationalize AI\-enabled solutions on Azure. You’ll work across the lifecycle—from ingesting and modeling data to orchestrating LLM\-powered workflows (incl. **RAG**)—with strong emphasis on reliability, security, cost efficiency, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate is comfortable converting moderately detailed requirements into robust designs and high\-quality code. This role is strictly involved in development of product and does not involve direct access to Protected Health Information (PHI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), or any secured or confidential client data. The work is limited to product development and does not include handling or processing of sensitive health or personal information.


**Your role in our mission**
----------------------------

  

Design and implement **retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)** pipelines: document preprocessing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, grounding/citations, prompt templating.


Build and integrate **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** tools/servers to expose enterprise systems and data sources to LLMs securely.


Develop orchestration layers (tool/function calling, guardrails, prompt contracts) using **Azure OpenAI** with frameworks like **Llamaindex**.


Build custom tools that can seamlessly interact with **GitHub Copilot** to act as force multiplier for the developers.


Build ingestion and transformation pipelines into **ADLS Gen2** (bronze/silver/gold), using efficient formats (**Parquet**, optionally **Delta**).


Implement ETL/ELT workflows and scheduling (e.g., **Data Factory**, Functions, Container Apps), with schema design for telemetry, operational metrics, and curated aggregates.


Productionize services on Azure (Functions, App Service/Container Apps, AKS as needed); implement **CI/CD** (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), testing, observability (App Insights/Log Analytics).


**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* + **Experience (5–7 years)** delivering production systems that combine data engineering with LLM applications.
	+ **Azure OpenAI** hands\-on experience (prompting, model selection, evals, guardrails) and LLM orchestration using **Semantic Kernel** or **LangChain**.
	+ **RAG** expertise: embeddings, hybrid search, chunking, query rewriting, grounding with citations; **Azure AI Search** (vector \+ keyword).
	+ **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**: building/integrating tools/servers to expose enterprise data to models securely.
	+ **Data Engineering (Azure):** ADLS Gen2 (bronze/silver/gold), ETL/ELT pipelines (Data Factory/Functions/Containers), Parquet; solid **schema design** and partitioning strategies.
	+ **Programming:** Strong **Python** (pandas), solid **SQL**; working **TypeScript** for integration or UI layers.
	+ **Analytics:** Practical statistics (A/B tests, t‑tests, DiD), time\-series analysis; **Power BI** modeling and dashboards.
	+ **DevOps:** CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), Docker; secrets and configuration management (**Key Vault**); logging/monitoring (**App Insights**).
**What you should expect in this role**
---------------------------------------


* Remote opportunity
* Willingness to report to Hyderabad office whenever required

title: Senior Application Architect - Assistant Vice President
description:
As a hands on **Technical Architect** , you will be responsible for **end\-to\-end architecture, design, and implementation** of mission\-critical systems. You will define both macro and micro level architecture and implement with engineering teams to **modernize a VC\+\+ platform into Reacts JS/Java based event based high throughput, low latency micro services based platform** , ensuring alignment with **cloud\-native principles** .


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Architecture \& Platform Design**


* Define and evolve the **architecture** for a **distributed, cloud\-native Investment Accounting platform** , aligned with enterprise principles (scalability, resiliency, availability).
* Design **modular microservices architectures** , ensuring clear service boundaries, domain\-driven design, and reusability across business capabilities.
* Establish **event\-driven architecture patterns** for real\-time processing, enabling decoupled and scalable workflows.
* Define **data architecture and integration patterns** , including unified data models, event contracts, and consistency strategies across IBOR/ABOR domains.
* Hands on experience and capability to walk the talk is critical. This is not architecture only role.

### **Modernization Leadership (VC\+\+ Java)**


* Lead the **modernization of legacy VC\+\+ systems** into Java\-based, distributed services
* Define **migration patterns, decomposition strategies** , and phased transformation roadmaps
* Ensure **functional equivalence where required** , while enabling architectural evolution beyond legacy constraints
* Guide teams on **translating low\-level C\+\+ constructs into scalable Java service patterns** (stateless services, async processing, etc.)

### **Performance, Throughput \& Scalability**


* Architect systems for **high\-throughput transaction processing** and near real\-time accounting workflows
* Define **cache\-driven design strategies** (distributed caching, in\-memory processing, read/write optimization)
* Establish performance benchmarks, scalability patterns, and capacity planning principles

### **Cloud\-Native \& Engineering**


* Design and implement for **cloud\-native** (containerization, orchestration, DevSecOps).
* Establish cross\-cutting capabilities:


	+ **Observability (logging, metrics, tracing)** for operational intelligence
	+ **Resiliency patterns** (retry, circuit breaker, idempotency)
	+ **Security and compliance controls**
* Ensure **API\-first and contract\-first design principles** are adhered to.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* Extensive experience in **software architecture and distributed systems design**
* Strong programming background in **VC\+\+ and Java** , with proven experience in system modernization.
* Rich experience with AWS/Azure along with modern CICD platforms and pipeline as code.
* Deep expertise in:


	+ Event\-driven architectures
	+ Microservices and domain\-driven design
	+ High\-performance and low\-latency systems
* Experience building **large\-scale distributed systems with low latency and high throughput**
* Strong understanding of **data consistency, transaction processing, and accounting\-like systems**

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience in **Investment Accounting / Financial Services platforms** (transactions, valuations, positions, multi\-currency processing)
* Familiarity with:


	+ Observability and operational intelligence frameworks
	+ Unified data models and ledger\-based architectures
* Experience working in **regulatory and audit\-heavy environments** (traceability, reconciliation.

title: Senior Citrix/AVD Engineer
description:
At Coretek, we transform how organizations empower their workforce through secure, scalable, and modern digital workspaces. As a Coretek EUC Support Engineer, you will be a key member of our team, providing expert support for our enterprise managed services clients. In this role, you’ll ensure seamless, secure, and high\-performance virtual desktop experiences while occasionally contributing to project delivery initiatives. Your work will leverage leading technologies such as Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Nerdio, and Citrix to help clients maximize the value of their end\-user computing environments.


You will help Coretek clients succeed by combining deep technical expertise with a commitment to service excellence. Leveraging modern tools and practices—including Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation—you’ll ensure our clients' environments remain reliable, secure, and aligned with industry best practices. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a cloud\-first, customer\-obsessed environment where innovation, accountability, and impact drive everything we do.


This role blends project\-based work with operations and managed services engineering, supporting both daily incidents and long\-term platform health, governance, and continuous improvement.  



  

  

**Requirements**  

* Provide operational support for managed Citrix and AVD environments, including daily health checks, patching, upgrades, and incident remediation
* Administer and optimize Nerdio Manager for Enterprise and Citrix Director/Studio configurations
* Manage Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix Gateway (NetScaler), and endpoint management integrations
* Implement solutions leveraging existing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for environment automation (Terraform, Ansible, Packer, or Nerdio automation scripting)
* Monitor, analyze, and improve system performance, availability, and security posture across environments
* Deploy and enforce group policies, security baselines, and compliance configurations
* Develop and maintain standardized operational documentation, runbooks, and support playbooks
* Collaborate with internal architects and client stakeholders to ensure platform integrity and alignment with SLAs
* Participate in DR planning, testing, and execution for hosted EUC environments
* Respond to escalated tickets and serve as a technical escalation point for L1/L2 support teams
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior engineers and technicians

  

Requirements

* 7\+ years of experience in supporting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops or Azure Virtual Desktop in a managed services or enterprise environment
* Hands\-on experience with:


Citrix Suite: Studio, Director, NetScaler (Gateway), Citrix Policy, Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups


Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) deployments and management


Nerdio Manager for Enterprise (preferred)

* Understanding of how to use existing IaC tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, or PowerShell scripting
* Experience with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) and virtual networking in Microsoft Azure
* Familiarity with endpoint management and thin client configurations (e.g., Stratodesk, IGEL, Unicon)
* Solid understanding of Group Policy Objects (GPO), Active Directory, DNS, and Windows desktop/server internals
* Exposure to ITSM ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, etc.)
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently and communicate clearly with customers
* Experience with Imprivata support and implementation, including integration with virtual desktops and authentication workflows is a plus


Preferred Skills:

* Microsoft certifications (AZ\-104, AZ\-140, or Citrix Certified Associate – Virtualization)
* Experience with Citrix Cloud services and hybrid configurations
* Understanding of Zero Trust, conditional access, and modern endpoint security integrations
* Experience automating repetitive admin tasks or builds via Nerdio Runbooks or similar tools


What We Offer:

* Collaborative, cloud\-native engineering environment
* Exposure to cutting\-edge EUC and automation technologies
* Opportunities for growth into architecture or automation leadership

title: Data Architect (10+ Yrs)
description:
We are looking for The Data Architect who is responsible for designing and architecting enterprise\-wide Business Intelligence solutions for Seanergy and its clients, with a primary focus on Tableau reporting ecosystems and end\-to\-end Microsoft Fabric implementations. The role owns BI semantic models, data warehouse and database design, KPI frameworks, governance models, RLS/OLS standards, and performance optimization across the BI stack. The architect ensures scalable, secure, high\-performance BI systems aligned with business, technology, and client\-delivery goals.


#### **Key Skills:**


* Tableau (Server/Cloud, Prep, Bridge, LOD, RLS).
* Microsoft Fabric — OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Direct Lake, Data Factory, Power BI in Fabric.
* Proficiency in modern programming languages: Python, Go, Node.js, or similar.
* Data Warehousing \& Dimensional Modeling (Kimball, star/snowflake, SCD)
* SQL \& Database Management (Azure SQL, SQL Server, indexing, partitioning, tuning).
* ETL/ELT \& Cloud Data Platforms (ADF, Fabric Pipelines, dbt, Azure).
* Programming / Scripting (Python, DAX, Power Query M).
#### **Responsibilities:**


* Architect enterprise BI solutions on Tableau (Server/Cloud) and Microsoft Fabric — including semantic models, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting structures aligned with business outcomes.
* Design and own end\-to\-end Microsoft Fabric architecture — OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Direct Lake semantic models, Data Factory pipelines, Real\-Time Analytics, and Fabric administration and governance.
* Architect the Tableau ecosystem — Server/Cloud topology, extract vs. live connection strategy, LOD expressions, Row\-Level Security, Tableau Prep flows, publishing and content governance.
* Design scalable data warehouse and database structures — Kimball dimensional models (star/snowflake), SCD strategies, indexing, partitioning, and query performance tuning across Azure SQL, SQL Server, and Fabric Warehouse.
* Review BI developer work, guide technical choices, and mentor teams on Tableau, Fabric, dimensional modeling, and database best practices.
#### **Required Skills \& Experience:**


Years of Experience: 10\+ years in BI, data warehousing, or analytics architecture. 10\+ years in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or Data Analytics, with 3\+ years in a BI Architect / Solution Architect role. Deep, hands\-on expertise architecting BI solutions on Tableau (Server/Cloud) — publishing strategy, RLS, LOD expressions, extract optimization, Tableau Prep. Strong hands\-on experience across the complete Microsoft Fabric stack — OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Direct Lake semantic models, Data Factory, and Fabric administration

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical fields.
